reason: Provides same-machine, same-user messaging and presence discovery between DSH sessions using a local registry and inbox files, with peer messages injected as labeled turns.

summaries.zh: 在同一台机器上为同一用户运行的 DSH 会话提供在线发现、状态查看和带来源标记的跨会话消息传递。
summaries.en: Enables same-user DSH sessions on one machine to discover each other and exchange source-labeled messages through a local file-based registry and inbox.

capabilities: Discovers live DSH sessions on the same machine
Publishes local session heartbeats and metadata
Sends messages between same-user sessions through local inbox files
Injects accepted peer messages into active sessions as labeled turns
